mono-0806.d: One-point perspective corridor, a few frames receding into the distance, rays packed tight. For people who notice buildings.

mono-0819.d: Stippled grain cloud, hand-set dots gathering into separate masses, thick as static. A little retro, a little op-art.

mono-0830.d: Several families of sine waves crossing into a moiré. Pulses gently from a distance.

mono-0832.d: Dense concentric hexagons, twisting slowly inward. Balanced enough to calm a busy outfit.

mono-0841.d: Brutalist facade grid of wide bays, mostly open. Clean enough for the office, odd enough for the weekend.

mono-0854.d: Dot-matrix diamond on a chunky LED grid. Looks different up close than from afar.

mono-0872.d: Open concentric triangles, twisting slowly inward. Crisp edges, soft fabric.

mono-0874.d: Dot-matrix cross on a chunky LED grid. Printer's-proof texture, on purpose.
